label: Components and Delivery Formats of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Chronic Fatigue Syndrome/Myalgic Encephalomyelitis: A Systematic Review and Component Network Meta-Analysis.
summary: Chronic fatigue syndrome/myalgic encephalomyelitis (CFS/ME) is a debilitating condition characterized by persistent fatigue, impaired functioning, and substantial societal burden. Although cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is commonly used for CFS/ME, the effective components and delivery formats remain unclear.
